name: sol_token_nfe1_6
description: Marketplace/transfer logic mishandles NFTs that implement both ERC721 and ERC1155 interfaces
question: The source file in `source` implements NFT transfer or deposit logic that checks `supportsInterface` for ERC721 and ERC1155 as mutually exclusive branches (e.g. if/else-if), so a token contract implementing both standards is only processed via one branch, causing incorrect amount, ownership, or balance handling or unexpected reverts; this excludes code that explicitly supports tokens implementing both interfaces simultaneously or contracts intentionally restricted to a single token standard.
criteria: transferNFTs() uses `if (supportsInterface(ERC721_ID)) {...} else if (supportsInterface(ERC1155_ID)) {...}` treating the standards as mutually exclusive
code hardcodes amount = 1 whenever the ERC721 interface check passes, ignoring that the same token could also expose an ERC1155 balance/amount
transfer logic calls ownerOf() guarded only by an ERC721 interface check without verifying balanceOf() for tokens that also support ERC1155
deposit/withdraw function picks the transfer method (safeTransferFrom vs safeBatchTransferFrom) based solely on the first matching supportsInterface() result, misrouting dual-standard tokens
